titles.romaji: DARKER THAN BLACK: Kuro no Keiyakusha - Sakura no Hana no Mankai no Shita
titles.english: Darker than Black: Beneath Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom
titles.native: DARKER THAN BLACK -黒の契約者- 桜の花の満開の下

description: A side story of Darker than BLACK, also known as Episode 26. A Contractor was killed and it was rumored that his corpse and possessions were buried under a Sakura tree. Hei and the others (including the Police) decide to investigate.
